sections.heading: Randhir Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Randhir Kapoor was born on 15 February 1947 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Raj Kapoor and his mother, Krishna Kapoor. He is a sibling of Ritu Nanda, Rishi Kapoor, Rajiv Kapoor and Rima Jain.
His listed education includes Campion School, Mumbai.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
